description:
This requirement is for the performance of maintenance on the United States Naval Academy's Districuted Antenna System in accordance with the Statement of Work included within the attached Solicitation.

This requirement is being solicited on a sole-source basis (see attached Sole-Source Justification). Only the noted vendor may submit a quote in response to this solicitation for consideration for award.

This quote should be submitted to Contract Specialist Ashley Steele at ashley.n.steele8.civ@us.navy.mil. Only electronic reponses will be accepted.
